{"consolidated_memory":"ingest/pipeline/parser.py: malformed record issues (two separate occasions)

**Occasion 1: [2026-01-29]**
- File: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- Problem: malformed record in parser; carries context from earlier malformed record work in same area
- Trigger: appeared only on staging read replica
- Signal: decode error pointing at one byte offset
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue (PR #6069, branch fix/malformed-record-1)
- Repro: feed mixed-encoding sample file
- Result: throughput rose 87 percent to 684 requests per second

**Occasion 2: [2026-02-05]**
- File: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side)
- Problem: malformed record in parser
- Trigger: appeared only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Signal: decode error pointing at one byte offset
- Root cause: two writes never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #7926, branch fix/malformed-record-2)
- Repro: feed mixed-encoding sample file
- Result: reclaimed 43 GB of blob storage
- Stack: Python
- Test coverage: tests/ingest/test_parser.py"}
